prompts.label: Small Minecraft
prompts.prompt: I need a Minecraft Discord for about 20 mates. Keep it chill and simple. We need somewhere to chat, show builds, one general voice channel and occasional events. No tickets, no massive staff structure.

prompts.label: Large professional Minecraft
prompts.prompt: I need a professional public Minecraft Discord for around 2,000 members. We run weekly tournaments, have a staff team, need applications, support tickets, announcements, several voice channels, a media section and team areas.

prompts.label: Explicit exclusions
prompts.prompt: Make me a gaming community server for around 100 people. We mainly play Minecraft and Rocket League. We want general chat, game channels, voice channels and occasional events. Do not add tickets, applications, staff recruitment, economy systems or premium/VIP roles.

prompts.label: Messy natural language
prompts.prompt: yo basically me and a bunch of people are making a server, probably like 60 or 70 people, we play minecraft mostly but sometimes other stuff too. want it to feel active but not like one of those huge public servers. probably need chat, some vcs, somewhere for screenshots/builds and maybe events. don't overdo it

prompts.label: Events but not tournaments
prompts.prompt: We have a 150-member community. We sometimes run community events like movie nights, game nights and Q&As. We need an events area and announcements, but we are NOT a competitive gaming server and do not need tournaments, teams or player recruitment.
